putInAccess.sourceName: BLM Bobcat-Houlihan recreation area; Wyoming Game and Fish public access area and boating inventory
putInAccess.note: WGFD lists Bobcat-Hoolihan as launch and egress; its public-access map and the BLM recreation map confirm the public parcel, parking and river access. The WGFD boating point lies farther downstream near the parcel boundary and is not adopted as an exact landing. The marker instead uses BLM’s published trailhead coordinate. No surveyed landing, river bank side or walking/driving connection is claimed. BLM’s March 2026 announcement confirms new South Fork launches but does not name all three, so it is not used to identify this site as a new ramp.
putInAccess.directions: Use the BLM-signed Bobcat-Houlihan recreation area via Park County Road 6EH off South Fork Highway. The pin is the public facility area inland of the river. Follow posted public access signs and confirm a practical carry on site; do not use nearby private driveways or assume trailer-to-water access.
